intro: In this week’s digest, we explore how AI continues to reshape retail and luxury sectors, from Target’s AI-driven back-to-school strategy to Nvidia’s $13 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. We also examine emerging ecommerce tools, shifting consumer preferences toward affordable luxury, and the growing impact of social commerce through Sephora’s TikTok Shop initiatives.

items.title: How AI is powering Target’s back-to-school push
bullets: Customers who create wish lists through Target's AI-powered system generate approximately 45% higher demand in the back-to-school category.

Back-to-school spending is projected to reach $43.3 billion for K-12 students and $103.5 billion for college students in 2026, according to the National Retail Federation and Prosper Insights & Analytics.

items.title: Nvidia buying artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face for $13 billion
bullets: Nvidia announced its acquisition of the AI platform Hugging Face for approximately $12.93 billion to expand its presence in the open-source AI model market.
Hugging Face serves over 18 million developers and hosts more than 3 million models, 500,000 datasets, and 1 million applications used by over 200,000 companies.
Founded in 2016 and valued at $4.5 billion in August 2023, Hugging Face offers datasets, software libraries, and cloud services for building and deploying AI applications.
items.summary: AI-generated summary: Nvidia announced its $13 billion acquisition of the AI platform Hugging Face, which is used by over 18 million developers, researchers, and creators, as well as more than 200,000 companies, to share millions of models, data sets, and applications.

items.title: Affordable Luxury Is Gaining Ground in Department Stores
bullets: The International Association of Department Stores reported that contemporary and premium brands now dominate women's fashion floors, accounting for 31 percent of the market share. At Tryano in Abu Dhabi, the 400 to 800 euro price bracket showed the strongest sell-through rates, indicating consumer preference for affordable luxury. IADS members operate more than 563 stores across 32 countries, with women's fashion online sales increasing to 22 percent of department store sales in 2025 from 20 percent the previous year.

items.title: New Ecommerce Tools: September 2, 2026
bullets: dLocal launched dMoRe, a merchant of record service that integrates payment rails with local compliance and banking partnerships to help enterprises scale globally.
Runable raised $21 million in funding to expand its AI agent platform that assists small businesses with shipping, marketing, and customer support.
Amazon products can now be tagged in YouTube Shopping videos and livestreams, allowing U.S. creators to earn commissions through the affiliate program.

items.title: ‘Model fatigue’ sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions at frenetic pace
bullets: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, and Google all released new AI model updates within the same week, intensifying competition in the AI industry. Nvidia announced its plan to acquire the open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, expanding its AI model offerings. Gartner projects global AI spending will reach $2.59 trillion in 2026, with over $1 trillion allocated to services, software, cybersecurity, and AI tools.

items.title: Sephora plans exclusive drops for TikTok Shop
bullets: Sephora is launching a new monthly livestreamed shopping experience called Sephora Drop Shop on TikTok Shop, starting September 19 in the U.S., featuring celebrity hosts and creator content.
The beauty category on TikTok generates over a billion beauty-related searches each month, highlighting the platform's strong engagement with beauty content.
Sephora's initiative is part of a broader strategy to reach younger consumers and test digital innovations before potentially expanding globally.
items.summary: AI-generated summary: Beauty retailer Sephora is launching a “Sephora Drop Shop” on TikTok Shop in the U.S. starting September 19, featuring monthly livestreamed product launches with celebrity hosts and creators to engage TikTok’s beauty-focused audience.
